entities.name: 1920x1200
entities.summary: The 1920x1200 resolution is the native display setting for the 14-inch matte panel on the ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 11, confirmed by both xrandr in Fedora and Windows Display Settings. It has a 16:10 aspect ratio, providing more vertical space compared to 16:9 displays. This resolution was verified in late March 2024 after a discrepancy was noted with Lenovo's PSREF database, which incorrectly listed a higher resolution for the same SKU. The 1920x1200 resolution is used for daily tasks and development work in both operating systems.
